resetConfirm: Reset all settings to KronOS defaults?

plugins.title: Desktop plugins
plugins.blurb: Bundled or dropped into the desktop-plugins folder. Disable to unload live.

agent.title: Agent plugins
agent.blurb: Run in the KronOS backend — tools, skills, MCP servers, hooks, and slash commands. Portable ones are Agent Plugins packages (skills + MCP bundles that work in other agents too). Toggles apply to new sessions.
agent.updateBackendToManage: Update the KronOS backend to manage this plugin from Desktop.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.intro: OS notifications (not in-app toasts). Per device.
notifications.focusedHint: Completion alerts only fire while KronOS is in the background.

approval.label: Approval needed
approval.description: A command is waiting for you to approve or reject it.

input.label: Input needed
input.description: KronOS asked a question or needs a password or secret.

turnDone.label: Response ready
turnDone.description: A turn finished while KronOS was in the background.

credits.label: Credit alerts
credits.description: Credit access is paused or restored.

plugin.label: Plugin notifications
plugin.description: A desktop plugin sent a notification while KronOS was in the background.

notifications.testSent: Test sent. If nothing appears, check your OS notification permissions and Focus/Do Not Disturb.
notifications.testUnsupported: This system does not support native notifications.
notifications.completionSoundDesc: Plays when an agent turn finishes. Pick a preset and preview it here.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.intro: Desktop-only. Mode is brightness; theme is palette and chat chrome.
appearance.colorModeDesc: Pick a fixed mode or let KronOS follow your system setting.
appearance.toolViewDesc: Product hides raw tool payloads; Technical shows full input/output.
appearance.reasoningCollapsedDesc: Keep streamed reasoning available without expanding it until you open it.
appearance.interfaceFontDesc: Changes the typeface in workspace controls, settings, and chat.
appearance.buttonStyleDesc: Changes how secondary and selected buttons look.
appearance.sessionDensityDesc: Choose how much context appears beneath session titles in the sidebar.
appearance.terminalFontDesc: Choose an installed font for Desktop terminals. Nerd Fonts render Powerlevel10k and shell icons; leave blank to use bundled JetBrains Mono.
appearance.terminalFontPlaceholder: MesloLGS NF or a CSS font stack
appearance.translucencyDesc: See your desktop through the whole window. macOS and Windows only.
appearance.backdropDesc: The faint statue image behind the conversation.
appearance.reactionsDesc: iMessage-style emoji tapbacks — react to messages, and KronOS can react to yours.
appearance.composerPopoutDesc: Allow dragging the composer out of its dock. Turn this off to keep it locked at the bottom.
appearance.embedsDesc: Rich previews load from third-party sites (YouTube, X, …). Ask shows a placeholder until you allow each one; Always loads them automatically; Off keeps plain links.
appearance.productDesc: Human-friendly tool activity with concise summaries.
appearance.technicalDesc: Include raw tool args/results and low-level details.
appearance.themeDesc: Desktop palettes only. The selected mode is applied on top.
appearance.installDesc: Paste a Marketplace extension id (e.g. dracula-theme.theme-dracula) to convert its color theme into a desktop palette.

pet.title: Pet
pet.intro: Adopt an animated petdex mascot that floats over the app and reacts to what KronOS is doing — running while tools execute, celebrating on success, sulking on errors.
pet.restartHint: Pets need a quick restart — the running app started before this feature was added. Quit and reopen KronOS, then come back here.
pet.scaleDesc: Resize the floating mascot. Applies everywhere instantly.
pet.roamDesc: Let the pet wander the window on its own while idle.
pet.chooseDesc: Picking one installs it (if needed) and makes it active.
pet.unreachable: Couldn't reach the petdex gallery. Check your connection and reopen this page.
pet.deleteBody: This permanently deletes the pet — it can't be reinstalled.
pet.noneAvailable: No pets available to turn on right now.
pet.turnOnFailed: Could not turn the pet on.
pet.turnOffFailed: Could not turn the pet off.

fieldDescriptions.model: Used for new chats unless you pick a different model in the composer.
fieldDescriptions.modelContextLength: Leave at 0 to use the selected model's detected context window.
fieldDescriptions.fallbackProviders: Backup provider:model entries to try if the default model fails.
fieldDescriptions.display.personality: Default assistant style for new sessions.
fieldDescriptions.display.showReasoning: Show reasoning sections when the backend provides them.
fieldDescriptions.desktop.repoScanEnabled: Scan local folders for Git repositories to show in Projects.
fieldDescriptions.desktop.repoScanRoots: Folders to scan. Leave empty to scan your home directory.
fieldDescriptions.desktop.repoScanExcludePaths: Folders and their descendants to skip during repository discovery.
fieldDescriptions.timezone: IANA timezone identifier. Blank uses the system timezone.
fieldDescriptions.agent.imageInputMode: Controls how image attachments are sent to the model.
fieldDescriptions.agent.maxTurns: Upper bound for tool-calling turns before KronOS stops a run.
fieldDescriptions.terminal.cwd: Default project folder for tool and terminal work.
fieldDescriptions.terminal.persistentShell: Keep shell state between commands when the backend supports it.
fieldDescriptions.terminal.envPassthrough: Environment variables to pass into tool execution.
fieldDescriptions.terminal.dockerImage: Container image used when the execution backend is Docker.
fieldDescriptions.terminal.singularityImage: Image used when the execution backend is Singularity.
fieldDescriptions.terminal.modalImage: Image used when the execution backend is Modal.
fieldDescriptions.terminal.daytonaImage: Image used when the execution backend is Daytona.
fieldDescriptions.codeExecution.mode: How strictly code execution is scoped to the current project.
fieldDescriptions.fileReadMaxChars: Maximum characters Hermes can read from one file request.
fieldDescriptions.approvals.mode: How KronOS handles commands that need explicit approval.
fieldDescriptions.approvals.timeout: How long approval prompts wait before timing out.
fieldDescriptions.security.redactSecrets: Hide detected secrets from model-visible content when possible.
fieldDescriptions.checkpoints.enabled: Create rollback snapshots before file edits.
fieldDescriptions.memory.memoryEnabled: Save durable memories that can help future sessions.
fieldDescriptions.memory.userProfileEnabled: Maintain a compact profile of user preferences.
fieldDescriptions.context.engine: Strategy for managing long conversations near the context limit.
fieldDescriptions.compression.enabled: Summarize older context when conversations get large.
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.voiceId: xAI voice ID (e.g. eve) or a custom voice ID.
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.language: Spoken language code (e.g. en, pt-BR) or "auto" for auto-detection.
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.autoSpeechTags: Let an LLM insert expressive audio tags ([laughing], [sighs]) into the script before synthesis.
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.optimizeStreamingLatency: Latency vs. quality trade-off. 0 = best quality, 2 = lowest latency.
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.sampleRate: Audio sample rate in Hz. Higher = better quality, larger files.
fieldDescriptions.tts.xai.bitRate: MP3 bitrate in bps. Only applies when codec is mp3.
fieldDescriptions.stt.enabled: Enable local or provider-backed speech transcription.
fieldDescriptions.stt.echoTranscripts: Post the raw 🎙️ transcript of voice messages back to the chat.
fieldDescriptions.stt.elevenlabs.languageCode: Optional ISO-639-3 language code. Blank lets ElevenLabs auto-detect.
fieldDescriptions.updates.nonInteractiveLocalChanges: When Hermes updates itself from the app (no terminal prompt), keep local source edits (stash) or throw them away (discard). Terminal updates always ask.

about.heading: KronOS Desktop
about.cantUpdate: This build can't update itself from inside the app.
about.cantReach: We couldn't reach the update server.
about.tapCheck: Tap "Check now" to look for updates.
about.automaticUpdatesDesc: KronOS checks for updates automatically in the background and lets you know when one is ready.

config.emptyDesc: This section has no adjustable settings.
config.toolsetsWipeConfirm: Remove all enabled toolsets? This disables memory, terminal, web search, delegation, and most other tools until you re-enable them.
config.keepAwakeDesc: Stop this machine from sleeping so long or overnight runs keep going. The display can still dim.
config.disableF12Desc: Block F12 from opening Developer Tools. Ctrl+Shift+I (or Cmd+Opt+I on Mac) still works.
config.attachmentSizeDesc: How big a local file Desktop will load for previews and image attach, in MB. Default is 16. Remote non-image attach uses a separate 256 MB cap. Setting this very high loads the whole file into memory and can freeze or crash the app.
config.attachmentSizeLabel: Max preview / image load size in megabytes

quickEntry.enabledDesc: Summon a small composer from anywhere with a global shortcut and fire a prompt without opening KronOS.
quickEntry.shortcutDesc: Needs at least one modifier, e.g. CommandOrControl+Shift+Space.
quickEntry.takenBy: Another app already uses this shortcut — pick a different one.
quickEntry.invalidShortcut: Not a valid shortcut. Include at least one modifier key.

connections.title: Connections
connections.intro: Register every place your agents live — this device, remote gateways on your network, and KronOS Cloud instances. All of them are stored here.
connections.stagedNote: Chats and the agent roster follow the source you pick; the app-managed window backend is still chosen in Settings → Gateway.
connections.kindLocalDesc: The KronOS runtime managed by this app.
connections.kindRemoteDesc: A KronOS gateway reachable over HTTP(S) — LAN, Tailscale, or the internet.
connections.kindCloudDesc: A hosted instance discovered through your KronOS Cloud account.
connections.kindSshDesc: A KronOS install reached over SSH.
connections.labelDesc: Required. Shown everywhere this instance appears; must be unique (e.g. “Homelab”, “Work laptop”).

gateway.unavailableDesc: The desktop IPC bridge does not expose gateway settings.
gateway.title: Gateway Connection
gateway.intro: Local by default. Use remote when this app should drive a KronOS backend elsewhere. Per-profile overrides below.
gateway.defaultConnection: Default connection for every profile that has no override of its own.
gateway.envOverrideTitle: Environment variables are controlling this desktop session.
gateway.envOverrideDesc: Unset HERMES_DESKTOP_REMOTE_URL and HERMES_DESKTOP_REMOTE_TOKEN to use the saved setting below.
gateway.localDesc: Start a private KronOS backend on localhost. This is the default and works offline.
gateway.inheritDesc: Remove this profile's override and use the default connection.
gateway.remoteDesc: Connect this desktop shell to a remote KronOS backend.
gateway.remoteAuthHint: Hosted gateways use OAuth or a username and password; self-hosted ones may use a session token.
gateway.cloudDesc: Sign in once to KronOS Cloud and pick from the agents on your account — no URL to paste.
gateway.cloudNeedsSignIn: Sign in to KronOS Cloud to discover the agents on your account.
gateway.cloudSignedInDesc: You are signed in. Pick an agent below; the session refreshes automatically.

cloudNoAgents.before: No agents found on this account. Create one in the

gateway.cloudDiscoverFailed: Could not load your KronOS Cloud agents
gateway.cloudConnectFailed: Could not connect to that agent
gateway.remoteUrlDesc: Base URL for the remote dashboard backend. Path prefixes are supported, for example /hermes.
gateway.probeError: Could not reach this gateway yet. Check the URL — the auth method will appear once it responds.
gateway.authSignedInPassword: This gateway uses a username and password. You are signed in; the session refreshes automatically.
gateway.authSignedInOauth: This gateway uses OAuth. You are signed in; the session refreshes automatically.
gateway.authNeedsPassword: This gateway uses a username and password. Sign in to authorize this desktop app.
gateway.tokenDesc: The dashboard session token used for REST and WebSocket access. Leave blank to keep the saved token.
gateway.plainTextConfirmTitle: Store the gateway token in plain text?
gateway.plainTextConfirmDesc: No OS keyring service was found on this machine, so the token would be saved unencrypted in the app’s connection settings file, readable by any process running as this user. Install or enable GNOME Keyring or KWallet for encrypted storage.
gateway.plainTextStoredDesc: Secure storage is unavailable, so the saved token is stored unencrypted in the app’s connection settings file on this machine. Install or enable GNOME Keyring or KWallet to encrypt it.
gateway.diagnosticsDesc: Reveal desktop.log in your file manager — useful when the gateway fails to start.
gateway.incompleteSignIn: Enter a remote URL and sign in before switching to remote.
gateway.incompleteToken: Enter a remote URL and session token before switching to remote.
gateway.incompleteSignInTest: Enter a remote URL and sign in before testing.
gateway.incompleteTokenTest: Enter a remote URL and session token before testing.
gateway.restartingMessage: KronOS Desktop will reconnect using the saved settings — the shell stays open.
gateway.sshDesc: KronOS is launched on the remote over SSH and tunneled to this app — nothing to start or expose yourself. Requires working key-based SSH access to the host.
gateway.sshTrustHint: The first presented host key is trusted and pinned; later changes fail closed.
gateway.sshHostDesc: user@host, or a Host alias from ~/.ssh/config.
gateway.sshHostPickDesc: A Host alias from ~/.ssh/config, or Custom to type one.
gateway.sshKeyDesc: Private key path. Blank = ssh-agent or ~/.ssh/config.
gateway.sshHermesPathDesc: Full path to the remote hermes binary. Blank = auto-detect.
gateway.sshRemoteProfileDesc: Profile name on the remote host. Blank = use the Desktop profile name.
gateway.sshButtonsHint: Save applies on the next launch. Connect reconnects now.
gateway.sshIncompleteHost: Enter an SSH host before connecting.
gateway.sshErrUnreachable: Could not reach that host over SSH. Check the host, port, and your network.
gateway.sshErrAuth: SSH authentication failed. Load your key into the ssh-agent (ssh-add) or set an IdentityFile in ~/.ssh/config — KronOS runs ssh non-interactively.
gateway.sshErrHostKey: The host key has CHANGED since you last connected. Verify this is expected, then run ssh-keygen -R <host> and reconnect.
gateway.sshErrNotInstalled: KronOS is not installed on the remote host. Install it there (curl -fsSL https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/install.sh | sh) or set the KronOS path.
gateway.sshErrPlatform: Unsupported remote platform. KronOS Desktop SSH mode supports Linux, macOS, and Windows remote hosts.
gateway.sshErrTimeout: SSH connection timed out. The host may be unreachable or asleep.
gateway.sshErrUpdateRequired: Update KronOS on the remote host before connecting with Desktop SSH.

model.appliesDesc: Applies to new sessions. Use the model picker in the composer to hot-swap the active chat.
model.auxiliaryDesc: Helper tasks run on the main model by default. Assign a dedicated model to any task to override.
model.fallbackEmpty: No fallback models — the default model is used unless it fails.
model.notInCatalog: isn't in this provider's model list — calls may fall back to a backup.

providers.intro: Sign in with a subscription — no API key to copy. KronOS runs the browser sign-in for you, right here in the app.
providers.disconnectInTerminal: Disconnect (runs the removal command in the terminal)

localEndpoint.title: Local / custom endpoint
localEndpoint.description: Point KronOS at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Zyphra, vLLM, llama.cpp, Ollama, etc).

sessions.archivedIntro: Archived chats are hidden from the sidebar but keep all their messages. Ctrl/⌘-click a chat in the sidebar to archive it.
sessions.emptyArchivedDesc: Archive a chat to hide it here.
sessions.autoArchiveDesc: Automatically archive chats you haven't touched in a while. Pinned chats are never archived, and nothing is deleted — archived chats just move here.
sessions.defaultDirDesc: New sessions start in this folder unless you pick another. Leave it unset to use your home directory.
sessions.defaultDirUpdated: Default project directory updated — start a new chat (Ctrl/⌘+N) for it to take effect

toolsets.noProviderOptions: This toolset has no provider options — enable it and it works with your current setup.
toolsets.noProviders: No providers are available for this toolset right now.
toolsets.nousIncluded: Included with a Nous subscription — sign in to Nous Portal to activate.
toolsets.nousAuthDoneMessage: Your subscription backends are now active.
toolsets.nousAuthFailed: Nous Portal sign-in did not complete
toolsets.postSetupInstalledHint: Installed. Re-run setup only if something is broken.
toolsets.modelInactiveHint: Select this backend first to change its model.
